report: Andrea experienced nausea during lunch today, preventing her from eating. She was given an anti-emetic to alleviate her symptoms and then returned to bed to rest for an hour. Upon attempting to eat some toast afterwards, she vomited immediately. Since then, she has been unable to consume any food or drink. As a result, she has been started on subcutaneous fluids and has received an intramuscular injection of Zofran. A GP review is currently awaited.
